title: Only one Categories column is sorted at a time
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in as a user who holds the "Settings - Parts" permission, on the build under test. Open Settings -> Parts -> Categories.
  2. The shop is connected to QuickBooks (so the QuickBooks Products And Services column is shown).
  3. Seed categories that exercise the sort: click New Category and create names that mix case and numbers (e.g. "Tier 2", "Tier 9", "Tier 10", "alpha", "Beta"). The Default category already exists (e.g. "Uncategorized").
custom_steps:
1. Sort by Name, then click the QuickBooks Products And Services header.
  2. Read both headers' arrows.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Only one column is sorted at a time: while the QuickBooks Products And Services column is the sorted column, the Name header shows no arrow.

Source - where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-9667; story SV-10134 (S1, Categories - sort by name); "Settings Pricing And Categories Sorting" PRD (Confluence 578781186, Locked for build 2026-09-15), Story 1; design artboards "Categories - before/after" + "The three rules that bite"; read 30 Sep 2026.
